faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for PM Shri Govt. Higher Secondary School Kurshi, also known as PM Shri GHSS Kurshi. It is a government higher secondary school located in Umerkote, Odisha.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Guest Faculty (English). This position is for teaching English at the higher secondary level on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty (English)?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty (English) post. Candidates should refer to the official notification for any updates or specific details regarding this single position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for PM Shri GHSS Kurshi recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and submit it as per the instructions provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for Guest Faculty (English) post?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form for the Guest Faculty (English) post is 06 August 2026. Applicants are advised to submit their forms well in advance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in date, which is the date of reporting, for this recruitment is 07 August 2026. Candidates who have applied offline should report on this date for further selection process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty (English) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Guest Faculty (English) position is 65 years. There is no minimum age specified, but candidates must meet the maximum age criteria.

faq.question: Q8. What is the educational qualification required for Guest Faculty (English)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master Degree in English with at least 50% marks or an equivalent grade. Additionally, a B.Ed or equivalent degree from an NCTE recognized university is mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for Guest Faculty (English)?
faq.answer: The salary for Guest Faculty (English) is Rs. 400 per class, subject to a maximum of Rs. 20000 per month. This contractual remuneration is based on the number of classes taken.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty (English) post primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will need to present their original documents for verification on the specified reporting date.
